title: Retribuere dignare, Domine (Jachet)
desc: Jachet of Mantua, Retribuere dignare, Domine. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From The 1520s Project (1520s-project.org, Jom2013); encoded by Benjamin Ory. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
